// diagnostic E0853

Jet.ModuleAliasValueMismatch

Value argument has wrong type

What

Value argument has wrong type

Why

Each value parameter of a generic module has a declared type, and the argument must have that type

Fix

Pass a value argument with the expected type.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ModuleAliasValueMismatch: Tests/UI/genmod_value_wrong_type.stderr.

Error: Jet.ModuleAliasValueMismatch: Value argument for `count` has the wrong type
  --> Tests/UI/genmod_value_wrong_type.jet:5:17
    |
  5 | instance: retry(true)
    |                 ^^^^
 Why: Expected exact `Int`, found `Bool`
 Fix: Pass a compile-time `Int` value without conversion
